108 days before 08-17-1018.  
1018 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not 400? 1018/4=254.5 → not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
Days in months before August in 1018: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31.  
From 08-17 go back 17 days to Aug 1: 17 days subtracted, 91 days left.  
From Aug 1 back through July (31 days) → June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28.  
Subtract July 31: 91-31=60 left, date at July 1.  
Subtract June 30: 60-30=30 left, date at June 1.  
Subtract May 31: 30-31 → goes into April, so 30 days before June 1 is May 2? Wait, careful:  
From June 1 back 30 days: May has 31 days, so May 2 is 30 days before June 1? Check: May 2 to June 1 = 31 days? Actually May 2 → May 31 = 30 days, then June 1 is next day, so 30 days before June 1 is May 2. Yes.  

Thus 108 days before 08-17-1018 is 1018-05-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1018-05-02
